claude_proposed_widenings.name: reduce_damage_taken
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The item's primary mechanic is a reaction that subtracts a numeric amount from the damage of the triggering hit after the attack has already hit. Existing atoms model AC changes, resistances, or healing, but not one-shot damage reduction on a resolved hit.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: If you're hit by an attack roll made with a Ranged or Thrown weapon while wearing these gloves, you can take a Reaction to reduce the damage by 1d10 plus your Dexterity modifier

claude_proposed_widenings.name: WeaponFilter.thrown_or_reaction_trigger_support_for_thrown_weapons
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The existing reaction trigger shape points to WeaponFilter, but the closed filter vocabulary does not honestly encode the SRD trigger's "Ranged or Thrown weapon" scope.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: hit by an attack roll made with a Ranged or Thrown weapon

claude_proposed_widenings.name: catch_triggering_ammunition_or_weapon
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The rider that lets the wearer catch the ammunition or thrown weapon when the reduced damage reaches 0 is a distinct mechanics outcome involving the triggering object and hand-capacity predicates. It cannot be expressed with current effect atoms.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: If you reduce the damage to 0, you can catch the ammunition or weapon if it is small enough for you to hold in that hand.
